Agency experience will be preferred. Educational background in Marketing or relevant discipline is required. Graduates from reputed universities will get priority. Strong copywriting skills in English and Bangla. Strong creative thinking and storytelling ability. Understanding of social media platforms and digital trends. Strong sense of fashion, aesthetics, and branding. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Responsibilities & Context Manage and oversee all digital platforms of assigned brands. Develop creative content ideas and write compelling copy for campaigns, social media, and marketing communications. Provide creative direction to designers, videographers, and editors. Plan and execute photoshoots, including outlet visits and in-house productions. Create content concepts, scripts, and briefs for campaigns and branding materials. Plan and execute marketing campaigns from concept to completion. Prepare and execute SMS marketing campaigns. Coordinate with agencies, internal teams, and international brand teams. Execute influencer marketing campaigns and brand collaborations. Analyze trends and develop content aligned with fashion trends and audience preferences. Prepare monthly content calendars and ensure timely execution. Generate campaign reports and monthly digital performance reports. Closet Social Limited, a concern of Masco Group, operates internationally renowned fashion brands in Bangladesh through official franchise partnerships, including MARIA.B Sapphire Sana Safinaz . We are looking for a creative, strategic, and trend-aware Content Specialist who is passionate about fashion, storytelling, and digital media. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka Read Before Apply Interested candidates are requested to send their CV and portfolio to: info@closetsocialbd.com Subject Line: Application for Content Specialist – Closet Social Limited (Please mention your expected salary in your CV).
